hero.title: Wednesday Family Meal
hero.description: Join us around the table for great food and wonderful fellowship before our evening activities begin.

intro.title: Dinner is Served
paragraphs: We believe some of the best conversations and deepest connections happen over a shared meal. Every Wednesday night, our dedicated kitchen team prepares a delicious, home-cooked dinner for the entire church family.
Whether you are a long-time member or a first-time guest, there is a seat saved just for you. Come straight from work or school, relax, and let us take care of the cooking.

details.label: Cost
details.value: Suggested donation of $5 per person, or $15 max per family. First-time guests eat free!

volunteer.title: Join the Kitchen Team
volunteer.description: It takes a lot of hands to feed our church family! If you have a passion for cooking, setting up, or even just washing dishes, we would love to have you on the rotation.
